note: `badgeId` is REQUIRED: a show names one badge.
A badge is shown as a whole; a single award cannot be shown on its own.
Showing does not pin: `pinned` is set with vtc/badges/mine/arrange, not here.
There is no `entryId`: a member shows only their own badge, never another holder's.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Response variant: `badge` is REQUIRED; the answer is the badge as the signer holds it, never empty.
